notes.title: Soundtrack/BGM DLC is up!
notes.content:
Hey, guys! 
The Winged Ones' BGM/Soundtrack DLC is now available at [url=https://sweetchiel.itch.io/new-nusantara-legend-of-the-winged-ones]itch.io[/url]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33987193/a9c7643d3e4ebe5fbcc63d80554ba9e3e426ba11.jpg[/img]

Enjoy a total of 33 Music Soundtrack of Nusantara: Legend of the Winged Ones, a collection through a strict selection from Kevin Macleod, Erdaenos, Roland M. Zabarjad, Kristy G. Lantang, Benjamin Mastripolito, and Lutfi Azandi!

I've received their permissions to distribute their wonderful music, the DLC also includes original lyric & music such as the Opening, Ending, Trailer, green2 (Forest BGM), and Tribal Music (Reksa's route).

Have fun & enjoy! 
If you want to use their tracks, refer to the "music copyrights.txt" for the direct sources to credit them ^.^)/
xoxo,

SweetChiel

P.S. I've been having problems with Steam's DLC tutorial video and I'm a bit afraid to mess with the codes so I've decided that any DLC I may have in the future, will be only available at itch.io!

P.S.S. this DLC is available for download for my $10 patrons on patreon <3

notes.title: Bundle of Joy!
notes.content:
Hi guys! 
How have you been?

My team and I have been busy with our second project, 'Nusantara: Bermuda Triangle', but we also planned a few things for Winged Ones:

- We're planning to release a soundtrack DLC pack. Including original BGMs and royalty free ones from Kevin Macleod and other amazing composers! Stay tuned!

- I'm happy to announce that you can now purchase 'Nusantara: Legend of the Winged Ones' bundled with other classic games in Groupees! With only $5 you can get 8 games, 4 soundtrack, and 1 digital comic!

If you're interested, look up 'groupees be mine 38'.
The bundle is called 'Be Mine 38' and Groupees has been making bundles since 2011 so you'll definitely find great deals you can't find anywhere else  ^.^)/

Good game and have fun!
xoxo,

SweetChiel

P.S. This is not April Fool and the bundle is time limited so make sure you get one before time out!

notes.title: Update 12/20/2018!
notes.content:
- Some players seem to have a glitch where the achievements unlocked themselves the moment they clicked 'start'.

I didn't find anything strange with the codes, so I'm unsure whether it's because of Steam's unstable server or if I can fix this or not, so for now, I tried to replace the steam library support folder with a new one + reset the persistent data via Ren'Py. At the same time, I'll report this glitch to Steam support.

- 'Voice volume' in preference screen is deleted.

After you downloaded the update, new players, please comment here if the problem still exist or if the problem is solved.

Thank you for your patience and I apologize for the discomfort this has caused you m(_ _)m 

xoxo,

SweetChiel

Update: after testing with a few different computers, the glitch is solved but there's a side effect; the CG gallery became reset too. For that, I apologize for the disconvenience m(_ _)m

notes.title: Fixed Achievement System!
notes.content:
Hi guys!
Good evening -or good morning! Depending on where you are on the globe!

I have good news! 
The Achievement system should work after you download the update!

I thought it didn't work because "Steam is still learning this game", but I was wrong -it was because my Steam Support Library version didn't match with my Ren'Py version...

However, I'm very glad to finally have it working now! It won't contribute to global achievement count and cannot be shown in a Steam Profile's Achievement Showcase yet, but at least we're a step closer now ^.^ 

I think we'd need to wait for about a month when Steam calculates Winged Ones' first sale result and reviews. Valve doesn't leak how many sales or how many reviews I need to pass the inspection, but fingers crossed!

And so, I bid good night and good luck to you on completing the Achievement!
xoxo,

SweetChiel

notes.title: Winged Ones is now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33987193/ecc0c8b5653a32dd5e94d5fa38186927afb1e223.png[/img]

Wohooo! Winged Ones has finally launched on Steam! 
Are you excited? I sure am!

Now, before we jump head first into playing, I have a few important things to tell both old and new players!

[b]Important Note: [/b]
1. For those who have played the game before through lemmasoft or itch.io, some of your progress may be shown in the Steam version due to the persistent data files saved in your computer. You may find that the encyclopedia and CG gallery are pre-filled and your old save files may display. This can be solved by finding any old Nusantara files on your system and deleting them before installing the Steam version.

2. While Steam is still learning about this game, please be patient if there's an error or if the Achievement system is not working normally. It should unlock soon and if there's a problem, I will do my best to promptly fix it and post an update on the situation!

3. Winged Ones will hold a 20% off launch discount on Steam! Collected funds will be used for Nusantara: Bermuda Triangle's development. However, Winged Ones will stay true to its free-to-play nature, so I'll also update the game build on itch.io and send giveaway keys for long-time supporters and backers! 
Either way, thank you for your support!

Last but not least, let's work hard together so we can unlock our Trading Cards feature! You can do so just by playing or leave a review of the game below~


xoxo,

SweetChiel

[b]P.S.[/b] Do you like the chibi art on top? Well, you're lucky 'cause I'm sharing the raw .psd file as a gift to thank everyone for their support! To download it, [b][url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/231834p1]click here[/url][/b]. You'll be directed to my Patreon page where I attached the .rar file ^.^
